headline: Borrowed from
women’s medicine.
dek: Two skin treatments in this lane were studied in women. One is an estrogen.
byline: Adonis Men’s Health · Checked Oct 31, 2026 · Clinical review pending

glance.label: Studied in women
glance.line: Spironolactone’s acne trials and estriol’s skin studies enrolled only women.

glance.label: Estriol
glance.line: An estrogen. No FDA-approved estriol product exists in the US.

glance.label: Banned in sport
glance.line: Spironolactone is named under S5, diuretics and masking agents.

summary: [[/spironolactone|Spironolactone]] was approved as Aldactone in 1960 for heart failure, high blood pressure and fluid build-up. Acne is not an approved use. Because it also blocks the male hormone receptor, it is prescribed off-label for acne in adult women, and both randomized acne trials, SAFA (410 women) and FASCE (133 women), enrolled only women. In men, the label says it can cause breast growth, lower libido and trouble with erections, and WADA bans it at all times as a diuretic.

[[/estriol|Estriol]] is an estrogen, one of the female hormones the body makes. In some European countries it is a prescription vaginal cream for postmenopausal women. FDA says there are no FDA-approved drugs containing estriol; marketed estriol drugs are compounded. Its skin evidence is two small 1990s studies, in 18 and 59 women around menopause, with no placebo group. We found no study of estriol on men’s skin.

For contrast, some skin treatments went through FDA approval. [[/tretinoin|Tretinoin]] was approved as Retin-A in 1971 for acne. [[/azelaic-acid|Azelaic acid]] is approved as Azelex for acne and Finacea for rosacea. [[/doxycycline|Doxycycline]] is an approved antibiotic, and Oracea was approved in 2006 for the bumps of rosacea. [[/niacinamide|Niacinamide]] has no FDA drug approval for any skin use. Compounded creams that combine these ingredients are not FDA approved.

The copper peptide [[/ghk-cu|GHK-Cu]] has the least behind it: it is not FDA approved for any use, and its only randomized human study, of 13 patients after laser resurfacing, found no measured difference in redness, wrinkles or skin quality. Whether estriol or spironolactone is safe on men’s skin over time is not known.

pull.quote: FDA does not have evidence that drugs containing estriol are safe and effective, or are “safer forms of estrogen.”

excerpts.quote: There are no FDA-approved drugs containing estriol. Marketed drugs that contain estriol are compounded drugs, which are not FDA-approved.

ALDACTONE can cause gynecomastia. In RALES, patients with heart failure treated with a mean dose of 26 mg of spironolactone once daily, about 9% of the male subjects developed gynecomastia. The risk of gynecomastia increases in a dose-dependent manner with an onset that varies widely from 1–2 months to over a year. Gynecomastia is usually reversible.
excerpts.note: Gynecomastia is breast growth in men.

excerpts.quote: Reproductive: Decreased libido, inability to achieve or maintain erection, irregular menses or amenorrhea, postmenopausal bleeding, breast and nipple pain.

All diuretics and masking agents, including all optical isomers, e.g. d- and l- where relevant, are prohibited. Including, but not limited to: • Diuretics such as: Acetazolamide; amiloride; bumetanide; canrenone; chlortalidone; etacrynic acid; furosemide; indapamide; metolazone; spironolactone
RETIN-A is indicated for topical application in the treatment of acne vulgaris.
Spironolactone improved outcomes compared with placebo, with greater differences at week 24 than week 12. Spironolactone is a useful alternative to oral antibiotics for women with acne.
excerpts.note: All 410 people in the trial were women.

excerpts.quote: Objective evaluation found no significant improvement in wrinkles or overall skin quality. However, patient satisfaction was significantly higher for those who used GHK-Cu skin care products after CO(2) laser skin resurfacing.
excerpts.source: Miller et al., Arch Facial Plast Surg
excerpts.note: 13 patients finished. This is GHK-Cu’s only randomized human study.
